name: Toast
description: Short, temporary notification. One framework-free toast() function renders into a shared region in the top layer (visible above dialogs). Supports text notifications, visual content previews (CardToast) for images, videos, and GIFs, and embedded in-place feedback (InlineToast).

classes.ayy-toaster: The shared region toast() creates (aria-live). Position via data-position; data-expanded on hover or focus.
classes.ayy-toaster__clear: "Clear all" button in the open stack's top-end corner (bottom-end under a top-positioned stack); shown only while the stack is open with two or more toasts.
classes.ayy-toast: One toast; stacked card with swipe-to-dismiss.
classes.ayy-toast--destructive: Destructive variant with cancel icon; announced with role="alert".
classes.ayy-toast--card: Card toast variant with media preview and action scrim.
classes.ayy-toast--card-split: Split card toast variant with media preview thumbnail and text content details.
classes.ayy-toast--card-split--vertical: Vertical split card toast variant with media preview stacked above text details.
classes.ayy-toast--long: Long text variant with normal text size and copy button.
classes.ayy-toast--inline: Inline feedback pill embedded in a card, toolbar, or form without a toaster region.
classes.ayy-toast--inline--busy: Busy tone for inline toast with spinner.
classes.ayy-toast--inline--error: Error tone for inline toast with alert icon.
classes.ayy-toast__copy: Copy button to copy message to clipboard.
classes.ayy-toast__image: Foreground preview image or video frame.
classes.ayy-toast__thumb: Thumbnail container for split card toast preview image.
classes.ayy-toast__scrim: Action overlay visible on card hover or focus.
classes.ayy-toast__center: Center primary and secondary action buttons.
classes.ayy-toast__status: Inline feedback pill after an action.
classes.ayy-toast__status--error: Error status tone with alert icon.

default.looks: Raised card with line-strong border, overlay shadow, and stacked offset; success, warning, destructive, and info include their status icon.

hover.looks: Deck expands vertically so all toasts fan out into readable view and timers pause across the stack. Card toast reveals action scrim. Close button gets wash-hover.

pressed.looks: Cursor changes to grabbing while dragging.

error.looks: Destructive icon in destructive colour. Only for errors that need no fixing in place; form errors go inline (FieldError).

loading.none: A toast confirms; for a long task show Progress where the work happens.

leaving.looks: Drifts out to the right (translateX 28px, scale 0.95, fade out) over 280ms.

sizes.width: min(22rem, viewport minus 2rem) or min(28rem, viewport minus 2rem) for long text toasts, stacked in the corner given by position; card toasts are min(17.5rem, 100%).

js: toast(message, { description?, variant?, duration?, action?: { label, onClick }, copyable?, copyText?, id? }) → { id, dismiss }; toast.success/warning/error/info/long(message, options); toast.card(options) → { id, dismiss, status }; toast.copy(text, options); cardToast(options); inlineToastClass({ tone?, className? }); toast.dismiss(id?); configureToaster({ position?, label?, closeLabel?, clearLabel? }); toastClass({ variant?, className? })

react.import: import { toast, Toaster, NotificationToast, Toast, InlineToast, CardToast, CardToastThumb, CardToastBackdrop, CardToastImage, CardToastMedia, CardToastScrim, CardToastClose, CardToastCorner, CardToastCenter, CardToastAction, CardToastStatus } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.title: ReactNode — message text
props.copyable: boolean — show copy button (default true for long variant)

a11y: The region is aria-live="polite"; destructive toasts use role="alert".
Timers pause while the toaster stack or a toast is hovered or focused, so there's time to read it and reach its action.
Messages are set with textContent — never HTML.
do: Use NotificationToast (or toast()) to confirm something happened (Saved, Deployed) or report an async receipt needing no decision.
Say what happened in 2–5 words: "Project deleted".
Offer one Undo-style action instead of a confirmation dialog for reversible actions.
Use CardToast (toast.card()) for content previews that are visual — screenshots, screen recordings, video frames, GIFs, and image downloads.
Use the split CardToast variation when the user needs both an image preview thumbnail and file metadata (filename, dimensions, size) with direct actions.
Use InlineToast for localized contextual feedback (e.g. "Copied to clipboard", loading spinner) embedded directly within a card, toolbar, or form without triggering the toaster region.
dont: Don't use a toast for errors the user must fix — show them inline next to the problem with FieldError.
Don't use a toast for anything needing a decision — use Dialog.
Don't put long or important content in a toast — it disappears.
Don't stack several toasts for one action — reuse an id to update it.
Don't put links the user must follow in a toast.
Don't use CardToast for plain text notifications that do not have a visual preview or thumbnail.
Don't use InlineToast as a floating viewport notification — use NotificationToast in the shared toaster region instead.
Don't stack multiple InlineToasts inside one container — update the status tone and message in place.
